# Original paramsd daemon oracle, source ba5def0

These files are **unchanged original controller observations**, extracted only
from `daemon/continuous/` and `daemon/restart/` in the public GitHub Actions
artifact `12305212845` (run `39510538880`, job `118930155954`, source
`ba5def0ab46de9cab2d3542af573625761068512`). The downloaded ZIP SHA-256 is
`a9a6fc6dcbf15af20696d832169ba81cf5cebe4364546466ccaa1b54b2a15ce2`.
The two `source.json` and two `input.json` files were bzip2-compressed byte-for-byte; no event,
number, ordering, or log field was normalized or regenerated. The `results`,
`gps`, and `saved` files are also the original artifact bytes. The archived
native-controller proof is deliberately excluded: it cannot serve as an
independent expected output.

The comparator checks current input file hashes against the controller's
same-run `source-identities.json`; it does **not** require the fresh JSON text
to have the old capture's hash. It compares the complete parsed input cases to
the sealed original, including metadata, service order and every raw input
packet. The restart `seed.LiveParametersV2` alone uses exact framed Cap'n Proto
bytes after zeroing only its validated root `Event.logMonoTime` eight-byte
word, because it is generated by the current continuous phase. Even one-bit
changes to another field or padding are rejected; every other restart seed
field remains exact. It then checks
all 1,210 ordered publications, original Event
projections, raw GPS, saved packet, gate, signal, exit, and bounded shutdown.
The original `rust/tools/check_paramsd_daemon.py` source was pinned at
`04a5433f356d594d3db8ce42394274e0bb1c856d20e975c5657285ce8f998b87`;
`rust/tools/paramsd_fixture.py` was pinned at
`8c0356bb780039c475def68358567489e036ab422921b8389bc7fbed20635521`.
It follows the existing source comparator's `2e-6` Event and `1e-9` other
finite-float tolerances. The original trace's internal `x`, `p`, and logs
cannot be compared to a daemon that does not publish them; the retained fresh
source test continues to cover that independent controller observation.

Integrate `paramsd_daemon_reference::compare_phase_before_receipt(name,
input_path, phase_dir, &report)` after each phase writes packets, GPS and saved
bytes but **before** that phase's `result.json` with `pass:true` is written.
Check cancellation again before writing the phase receipt. Call
`compare_before_receipt` again after both phase receipts and
`source-identities.json`, before the top-level successful `result.json`; this
rechecks same-run identities, both phases and cross-restart saved bytes. An
error at either boundary must prevent a successful receipt. Keep the existing
fresh-source `paramsd_daemon_reference.rs` test until
a separate same-ELF absence gate proves historical Python retirement.
